|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 (version 3 of 4): the Players Committee card image, which prints the original words of [[Senator Leia Organa]] again. It is listed as its own version because it was published (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). It is dated by its server upload date (25 February 2013); it may have been made earlier. The current text is [[Senator Leia Organa (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3).
* '''Original''' ([[Senator Leia Organa]]): Virtual Block 4 release sheet, official text as of 7 December 2009 (slip 72)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf#page=9 Virtual Block 4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"; copy re-made 20 April 2010, first printing not found), page 9, slip 72. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095223/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf#page=9 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Agendas: justice, rebellion. When deployed, may play a Defensive Shield from under your Starting Effect (as if from hand). While aboard Alderaan Consular Ship, it is immune to Lateral Damage and attrition. Attrition against opponent is +2 here.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB4-72-Senator_Leia_Organa.png]]) prints it. '''Document:''' release-sheet slip; slip number “72” bottom right, the Virtual Block 4 set mark.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Senator Leia Organa (Errata)]]): PC website card list, Virtual Block 4 list and Virtual master list, first archived 21 July 2012 (every capture with game text to 11 January 2013)<ref name="cl-1240_72">Players Committee website card list (Internet Archive captures): VBlock4Type (Virtual Block 4 list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001437/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 12 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111144021/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 11 January 2013]; VMasterType (Virtual master list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013]. Later captures carry no game text.</ref>: “Agendas: justice, rebellion. When deployed, may play a Defensive Shield from under your Starting Effect (as if from hand). While aboard Alderaan Consular Ship, it is Immune to Lateral Damage and attrition. Attrition against opponent is +2 here.” '''What changed:''' “it is immune to Lateral Damage” is written “it is Immune to Lateral Damage”, with a capital I. The same wording is already in the Holotable card data of 29 May 2010<ref name="cdf-1240_72">[https://github.com/ledwards/swccgvkit/blob/5047de0/db/lightside.cdf Holotable card data file, version 29 May 2010] (Holotable data, copy on GitHub). Card data is evidence only, not a card document.</ref>; that data is named only as evidence that the wording existed, not as a publication, and the version is dated by the card list. Icons written out in words, straight single quotes and credit lines in the list are not changes. '''Document:''' a text list on the website, with no card image.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB4-L-senatorleiaorgana-pre.gif]]): “Agendas: justice, rebellion. When deployed, may play a Defensive Shield from under your Starting Effect (as if from hand). While aboard Alderaan Consular Ship, it is immune to Lateral Damage and attrition. Attrition against opponent is +2 here.” '''What changed:''' the card-list changes are undone: the image prints the original words of [[Senator Leia Organa]] again, character for character. It is listed as its own version because it was published (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). '''Date:''' placed at its server upload date, 25 February 2013, when the Players Committee server received the Virtual Block 1–7 card images. The image may have been made earlier (Players Committee card images go back to the first Legacy releases), but nothing firmer dates it, so it is placed at the upload date (Bill, 11 November 2026: a PC card image is its own version, placed at its date; what was published last counts as current). '''Document:''' Players Committee card image; slip number “72” bottom right, as on the release-sheet slip, the Virtual Block 4 set mark, the whole card with the Decipher art.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Senator Leia Organa (Errata 3)]]): Master List (Light Side p. 14), official text as of 27 April 2013<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=14 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Agendas: justice, rebellion. When deployed, may play a Defensive Shield from under your Starting Effect (as if from hand). While aboard Alderaan Consular Ship, it is immune to Lateral Damage and attrition. Attrition against opponent is +2 here.” The Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1240-72-master.png]]) prints it. '''What changed:''' nothing against PC-E2; the Master List also prints the original words of [[Senator Leia Organa]] again, character for character. It is listed as its own version because it was published (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). '''Document:''' Master List slip; no slip number (the release-sheet slip and the card image print “72”), the Virtual Block 4 set mark.
